scripts.demo:game: bun run --filter @zyncbase/client build && zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast && bun run demo:game:dev
scripts.demo:game:build: bun run generate:check && bun run typecheck:examples && bun run --filter @zyncbase/client build && bun examples/cordon-off/build.ts
scripts.test:game: bun run generate:check && bun test examples/cordon-off && bun examples/cordon-off/smoke.ts && bun examples/cordon-off/smoke.ts --tls
scripts.test:tsan: bash scripts/tsan-prep.sh && zig build test -Dsanitize=thread --summary all --error-style minimal; tsan_exit=$?; bash scripts/tsan-prep.sh --restore; exit $tsan_exit
scripts.lint: zsort check . --ban-prefix ./ --ban-prefix src/ --remove-unused && zig fmt --check src && zlint --deny-warnings && zwanzig --format text src && zig build check --summary all
scripts.lint:fix: zsort fix . --ban-prefix ./ --ban-prefix src/ --remove-unused && zig fmt src
scripts.typecheck: bun run generate:check && bun run typecheck:sdk && bun run typecheck:e2e && bun run typecheck:examples
